title: Folded away in the memory of nature with her toys. Memories beset his brooding brain. Her glass of water from the kitchen tap when she had approached the sacrament. A cored apple, filled with brown sugar, roasting for her at the hob on a dark autumn evening. Her shapely fingernails reddened by the blood of squashed lice from the children’s shirts.
html_source: Stephen is just as consumed by his past (and present!) as we saw him in Portrait. His vivid memories make it hard for him to shake away the past and live in the moment.
